post_catalog: select jsonb_build_object('counts',jsonb_build_object('product',(select count(*) from garimpa.product),'observations',(select count(*) from garimpa.price_observation),'publications',(select count(*) from garimpa.publication),'clicks',(select count(*) from garimpa.click_event),'short_links',(select count(*) from garimpa.short_link),'assessments',(select count(*) from garimpa.editorial_assessment)),'secret_rows',(select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_secret),'secret_rls',(select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid='garimpa.affiliate_secret'::regclass),'secret_policy',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) from pg_policies p where schemaname='garimpa' and tablename='affiliate_secret'),'old_policies',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by tablename,policyname) from pg_policies p where schemaname='garimpa' and tablename<>'affiliate_secret'),'public_grants',(select count(*) from information_schema.role_table_grants where table_schema='garimpa' and table_name='affiliate_secret' and grantee in ('anon','authenticated','PUBLIC')),'resolvers',jsonb_build_object('accounts',to_regprocedure('garimpa.resolve_actor_accounts(text)') is not null,'identity',to_regprocedure('garimpa.resolve_actor_identity(text)') is not null,'device',to_regprocedure('garimpa.authenticate_extension_device(text)') is not null),'unauthorized_execution',has_function_privilege('anon','garimpa.resolve_actor_identity(text)','EXECUTE') or rolname='garimpa_app'),'broad_rls_not_applied',to_regprocedure('garimpa.active_tenant(text)') is null,'new_commercial_surface_absent',to_regclass('garimpa.campaign') is null and a.affiliate_id=m.affiliate_id)),true) from garimpa.app_user u join garimpa.affiliate_membership m on m.app_user_id=u.id and m.revoked_at is null join garimpa.affiliate_account acct on runtime_no_context: begin read only; set local role garimpa_app; select current_user as runtime_role, row_security_active('garimpa.affiliate_secret') as secret_rls_active, (select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_secret) as visible_secrets, has_table_privilege('anon','garimpa.affiliate_secret','SELECT') as anon_read, has_table_privilege('authenticated','garimpa.affiliate_secret','SELECT') as authenticated_read; commit;
runtime_house: begin read only; set local role garimpa_app; select set_config('garimpa.tenant_id','local',true), set_config('garimpa.membership_role','owner',true), set_config('garimpa.actor_type','human',true); select current_user as runtime_role, (select count(*) from garimpa.product where tenant_id='local') as house_products, (select count(*) from garimpa.publication where tenant_id='local') as house_publications, (select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_secret) as visible_secrets; commit;
integrity: select jsonb_build_object('m1_foreign_keys',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'validated',convalidated,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid)) order by conname) from pg_constraint where connamespace='garimpa'::regnamespace and conname in ('curation_event_actor_user_fkey','curation_event_actor_membership_fkey','editorial_assessment_actor_user_fkey')),'publication_product_tenant_mismatches',(select count(*) from garimpa.publication pub join garimpa.product p on p.id=pub.product_id where pub.tenant_id<>p.tenant_id),'publication_account_tenant_mismatches',(select count(*) from garimpa.publication pub join garimpa.affiliate_account a on a.id=pub.affiliate_id where pub.tenant_id<>a.tenant_id),'curation_actor_orphans',(select count(*) from garimpa.curation_event e left join garimpa.app_user u on u.id=e.actor_app_user_id where e.actor_app_user_id is not null and u.id is null),'editorial_actor_orphans',(select count(*) from garimpa.editorial_assessment e left join garimpa.app_user u on u.id=e.actor_app_user_id where u.id is null),'secret_foreign_keys_validated',(select bool_and(convalidated) from pg_constraint where conrelid='garimpa.affiliate_secret'::regclass and contype='f'),'pending_chain_count',(select count(*) from (values ('garimpa_tenant_rls_scoped'),('garimpa_price_evidence_canonical'),('garimpa_rubric_assessment_shadow'),('garimpa_audience_policy_and_opportunity'),('garimpa_commerce_and_campaign_link'),('garimpa_commercial_financial_ledger'),('garimpa_click_attribution_and_channels'),('garimpa_policy_experiments'),('garimpa_dispatch_jobs_outbox'),('garimpa_saas_onboarding_entitlements'),('garimpa_verified_workflows')) names(name) where not exists(select 1 from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations m where m.name=names.name))) as integrity;
